// @path: src/app/ops/schools/page.tsx
// @expect: OPS-IMPORT-ALLOWLIST
// src/app/admin/ is the SCHOOL console: a different trust level, tenant scoped,
// deliberately not scanned by this gate. Rendering it from ops would put every
// school's child-bearing console behind an operator login.
import { requireOperator } from "@/lib/ops/session";
import { AdminConsole } from "@/app/admin/AdminConsole";

export default async function OpsSchools() {
  await requireOperator();
  return <AdminConsole />;
}
